$comment: The files every app made from this template must carry byte for byte, and the fixes that
live inside files each app customises. scripts/template-sync.mjs reads it: `check` says
where an app has drifted, `apply` copies the shared files in. .github/workflows/fleet-drift.yml
runs `check` on every app in the KB's architecture/app-fleet.yaml each Monday and after every
merge here, and keeps one issue (label fleet-drift) listing what has not arrived.
An app in the fleet that is not under `untracked` is checked — a new app is covered the day
it is added to the fleet, which is what NBF and Brookfield missed (11 Nov 2026).

untracked.Tec-App: The Hub: its own codebase (tec-frontend/), not made from this template
untracked.Tec-Commerce: Older than the template; shares few of its files
untracked.Tec-Assets: Older than the template; shares few of its files
untracked.Tec-Ecommerce: Older than the template; a public shop with no /app door

Tec-Life.src/lib-client/hooks/usePiAuth.ts: Life does not carry this hook
Tec-Life.src/__tests__/session-cookies-renewal.te: Life has no logout route, so the logout half of this test is removed
Tec-Life.src/components/pi/SignInGate.tsx: Life's gate is src/app/app/components/SignInGate.tsx, translated through Life's i18n
Tec-Life.src/lib/sdk.ts: Life does not use the client sdk
Tec-Life.src/components/pioneer/QuestReturn.tsx: Colours from this repo's token map (the fleet's one variant)
Tec-Life.src/lib-client/pi/pi-auth.ts: Life signs in through pi-session (PiRuntime) only; it has no sdk-based sign-in

Tec-Connection.src/components/pioneer/QuestReturn.tsx: Colours from this repo's token map (the fleet's one variant)

Tec-Explorer.src/components/pioneer/QuestReturn.tsx: Colours from this repo's token map (the fleet's one variant)

Tec-Zone.src/app/pi-test/ArrivalTracePanel.tsx: Zone's panel writes its colours as literals; same panel otherwise

Tec-system.src/app/api/bff/subscription/cancel/rout: System sells no Pro — its one payment is a voluntary contribution, so there is nothing to cancel
